capturePolicy: Capture-only snapshots of production Alert.alert contracts. Buttons intentionally have no handlers, so evidence rendering cannot mutate fixture state.

dialog.account-delete-gate-1.title: Delete account & cloud data?
dialog.account-delete-gate-1.message: This deletes your Melo sign-in, encrypted cloud backup, and Melo’s stored bank connections. Money and history on this phone stay until you clear local data separately.

dialog.account-delete-gate-2.title: One bank permission remains separate
dialog.account-delete-gate-2.message: Melo deletes its provider credentials and stops future access. Your bank’s separate permission may remain until it expires, so revoke Melo in your bank too.

dialog.account-delete-gate-3.title: Delete your Melo account now?
dialog.account-delete-gate-3.message: This cannot be undone. Local money and history will remain on this phone.

dialog.account-sign-out-confirm.title: Sign out?
dialog.account-sign-out-confirm.message: You'll still keep everything on this device.

dialog.account-source-remove-confirm.title: Remove saved source?
dialog.account-source-remove-confirm.message: The encrypted original will be deleted. Confirmed money records stay in Melo.

dialog.bank-disconnect-confirm.title: Disconnect this bank?
dialog.bank-disconnect-confirm.message: Melo will delete its server-side connection identifier and stop future refreshes. Already accepted rows on this phone are a separate choice. TrueLayer Data v3 does not currently give Melo an API that can claim the bank-side consent itself was revoked.

dialog.bank-imported-history-choice.title: Keep imported history?
dialog.bank-imported-history-choice.message: The bank is disconnected from Melo. Rows already accepted on this phone can stay, or be removed separately now.

dialog.cloud-backup-delete-confirm.title: Delete cloud backup?
dialog.cloud-backup-delete-confirm.message: The encrypted cloud copy will be deleted. Everything on this device stays here.

dialog.cloud-backup-local-replace-confir.title: Replace this device’s Melo data?
dialog.cloud-backup-local-replace-confir.message: Backup for Alex from 18 Aug 2026, 08:00. 4 transactions, 2 subscriptions and 1 pots. Your current local state will be replaced.

dialog.cloud-backup-recovery-code-replac.title: Replace recovery code?
dialog.cloud-backup-recovery-code-replac.message: Melo will create a new code and immediately re-encrypt the latest backup. Store the new code when it appears.

dialog.edit-txn-receipt-source-choice.title: Add a receipt photo
dialog.edit-txn-receipt-source-choice.message: The original is encrypted in this workspace on this device.

dialog.edit-txn-unlink-receipt-confirm.title: Unlink this receipt?
dialog.edit-txn-unlink-receipt-confirm.message: The encrypted file stays in Statements & receipts. Only this transaction link is removed.

dialog.intake-image-source-choice.title: Add a statement image
dialog.intake-image-source-choice.message: Take a new photo or choose one already on this phone.

dialog.privacy-clear-gate-1.title: Clear local money and history?
dialog.privacy-clear-gate-1.message: This clears money, setup details, imports, history, widgets and app-owned export files from this device. It does not delete your sign-in, cloud backup or bank connections. Export first if you want to keep a copy.

dialog.privacy-clear-gate-2.title: Are you sure?
dialog.privacy-clear-gate-2.message: This local data cannot be recovered unless you already exported it or kept a separate encrypted cloud backup.

dialog.privacy-clear-gate-3.title: Clear this device now?
dialog.privacy-clear-gate-3.message: Local money, setup details and history will be removed. Remote account data stays until you delete it separately.

dialog.privacy-clear-result.title: Local data cleared
dialog.privacy-clear-result.message: Money, setup details, imports, history and app-owned export files were cleared from this device. Your sign-in, cloud backup and bank connections are separate and unchanged.

dialog.privacy-restore-gate-1.title: Restore from this export?
dialog.privacy-restore-gate-1.message: melo-export.json holds 4 transactions, 2 subscriptions and 1 pot for Alex. Loading it replaces everything currently in the app — export your current data first if you want to keep it.

dialog.privacy-restore-gate-2.title: Replace everything now?
dialog.privacy-restore-gate-2.message: What’s in the app now is overwritten by the file.
